source:
@@U02681@@
And when you are, you will summon
hero and heroine out of the night,
the first one bold enough to do the deed.
It will be done,
and you will have done it.
From then on, assisted by magic means,
the cloud of incense will transform itself into gods.

@@U02683@@
What now?

@@U02685@@
Strive downward with all of your being.
Stamp and you'll descend.
Stamp again and you'll rise.

@@U02686@@
(浮士德 stamps his foot and sinks out of sight.)

@@U02688@@
I really do hope the key works!
I’m curious to see if he returns.

@@U02690@@
EMPEROR and PRINCES.
The COURT in motion through the rooms.

@@U02692@@
(To 梅菲斯特.)

@@U02693@@
You still owe us the spectacle of the ghosts.
Get to work.
The Emperor is impatient.

@@U02695@@
His Majesty has just now enquired!
Hurry!
You don’t humiliate an emperor!
translation:
@@U02681@@
当你在的时候，你会召唤
黑夜里的男女主角，
第一个有足够勇气去做这件事的人。
一定会做到的，
你一定会做到的。
从此，在魔法手段的辅助下，
香云将化为神。

@@U02683@@
现在怎么办？

@@U02685@@
用你的全部存在向下努力。
踩一下，你就会下降。
再跺一下，你就会站起来。

@@U02686@@
（浮士德跺脚，消失不见。）

@@U02688@@
我真的希望钥匙能起作用！
我很好奇他是否回来。

@@U02690@@
皇帝和王子。
法庭在各个房间里移动。

@@U02692@@
（对梅菲斯特。）

@@U02693@@
你还欠我们鬼魂的奇观。
开始工作吧。
皇帝不耐烦了。

@@U02695@@
陛下刚才询问了！
匆忙！
你不许羞辱皇帝！
